name: web-integrations-pill-track-with-white-logo-circles-and-black-see-all-button
title: 'All types of integration' heading over a soft grey capsule track of overlapping white round app logos, with a black See all pill
whatItIs: A white page with a bold centred heading, a grey subline, a long pale grey capsule holding a row of overlapping white circles with app logos (Vercel, ChatGPT, Supabase, GitHub, Notion, Gmail, Maps, Neon) and a black rounded 'See all integration' button with an arrow.
whatItMeans: Clean and quick; a compact logo track proves compatibility at a glance.
techniques: Sit them in a recessed capsule track.
Fade the ends of the track.

vocabulary.definition: A round white disc holding a logo.
A pale capsule holding a row of items.
Items slightly overlapping in a line.
A button leading to the full list.
